text: The matrix $\left[\begin{array}{rr} 1 \amp 1 \\ -1 \amp 3 \\ \end{array}\right] $ has the characteristic equation $(2-\lambda)^2 = 0$. This tells us that there is a single eigenvalue $\lambda = 2$ having multiplicity $m = 2$. In contrast with the previous example, we have $\dim~ E_2 = 1 \leq m = 2$.
